platform-minimal-change-engineer.typicalTriggers: Surgical patch after root cause is known.
platform-minimal-change-engineer.forbiddenOwnershipAssumptions: Does not own architecture, RCA authority, or merge certification.

platform-codebase-archaeologist.typicalTriggers: Drift, duplication, partial migrations across branches.
platform-codebase-archaeologist.forbiddenOwnershipAssumptions: Does not rewrite history or merge PRs.

platform-code-reviewer.forbiddenOwnershipAssumptions: Does not write the patch or self-merge.

platform-reality-checker.forbiddenOwnershipAssumptions: Does not implement fixes or certify from chat summaries.

platform-evidence-collector.typicalTriggers: After implementation when evidence must be packaged.
platform-evidence-collector.forbiddenOwnershipAssumptions: Does not make quality claims beyond collected evidence.

platform-security-architect.typicalTriggers: New trust boundaries, privileged actions, AI tools, Device Packs.
platform-security-architect.forbiddenOwnershipAssumptions: Does not select unresolved crypto constructions or new OSS by fiat.

platform-appsec-engineer.typicalTriggers: Auth, input, queries, uploads, integrations, AI-generated code paths.
platform-appsec-engineer.forbiddenOwnershipAssumptions: Does not own identity product architecture (IAM engineer) or pack schema.

platform-ai-code-security-auditor.forbiddenOwnershipAssumptions: Does not become the implementing writer.

platform-secrets-credential-engineer.typicalTriggers: Credential Profiles, CI secrets, support bundles, redaction.
platform-secrets-credential-engineer.forbiddenOwnershipAssumptions: Does not design RBAC policy (IAM) or connector business logic.

platform-test-automation-engineer.typicalTriggers: When a changed invariant needs a durable automated test.
platform-test-automation-engineer.forbiddenOwnershipAssumptions: Does not weaken tests to obtain green CI.

platform-performance-benchmarker.typicalTriggers: Hot-path, sizing, lag, or resource-budget claims.
platform-performance-benchmarker.forbiddenOwnershipAssumptions: Does not invent universal SLO percentages or final benchmark constants.

platform-api-platform-engineer.typicalTriggers: Core APIs, Sensor/Agent control, ingestion, event schemas.
platform-api-platform-engineer.forbiddenOwnershipAssumptions: Does not own datastore engines or UI rendering.

platform-network-engineer.typicalTriggers: SNMP, ICMP, flow, syslog/traps, gNMI/NETCONF/SSH, routing/topology, discovery behavior.
platform-network-engineer.forbiddenOwnershipAssumptions: Does not own generic Sensor runtime (pools/leases/spool/uploader), Device Pack schema, or post-accept Kafka pipeline.

platform-database-reliability-engineer.typicalTriggers: PostgreSQL/ClickHouse schema, retention, backup/restore, data integrity.
platform-database-reliability-engineer.forbiddenOwnershipAssumptions: Does not own Kafka transport semantics or Sensor spool.

platform-sre.typicalTriggers: Service health, failover operability, runbooks, crash-loop diagnostics.
platform-sre.forbiddenOwnershipAssumptions: Does not invent two-Core replication designs or product SLOs that are Founder-reserved.

platform-identity-access-engineer.forbiddenOwnershipAssumptions: Does not own Notification Center product UX or Device Pack identity keys.

platform-knowledge-graph-engineer.typicalTriggers: Canonical relationships, topology history, provenance/confidence, RCA subgraphs.
platform-knowledge-graph-engineer.forbiddenOwnershipAssumptions: Does not select a new graph database or treat similarity as current cause.

platform-ai-engineer.typicalTriggers: AI Gateway, evidence-grounded LLM, anomaly/GNN scoring.
platform-ai-engineer.forbiddenOwnershipAssumptions: Does not make GNN/LLM causal authority or execute privileged actions.

platform-model-qa.typicalTriggers: Before enabling or promoting a model/policy.
platform-model-qa.forbiddenOwnershipAssumptions: Does not train across tenants or silently mutate active policy from feedback.

platform-devops-automator.typicalTriggers: CI, packaging, SBOM, compose, upgrade automation.
platform-devops-automator.forbiddenOwnershipAssumptions: Does not redesign production onto an unapproved cloud platform.

platform-git-workflow-master.typicalTriggers: Parallel branches, stacked PRs, integration, rebase coordination when authorized.
platform-git-workflow-master.forbiddenOwnershipAssumptions: Does not merge, force-push shared branches, or rewrite published history unless explicitly authorized.

platform-workflow-architect.forbiddenOwnershipAssumptions: Does not implement the flow or fill P0 TBD states.

platform-frontend-developer.typicalTriggers: After approved UX architecture and implementation-ready UI specification for operational screens.
platform-frontend-developer.forbiddenOwnershipAssumptions: Does not own product design authority, invent client-side authorization, or generic dashboards. Does not certify accessibility or final UI finish.

platform-ux-architect.typicalTriggers: Before major UI implementation: job/task flow, IA, taxonomy, navigation and cognitive-load architecture.
platform-ux-architect.forbiddenOwnershipAssumptions: Does not implement React, specify pixels/components, override RBAC, certify accessibility, or approve final UI finish.

platform-ui-finish-gate-reviewer.typicalTriggers: Independent final UI quality/adversarial review after implementation, before acceptance.
platform-ui-finish-gate-reviewer.forbiddenOwnershipAssumptions: Does not restyle to personal taste, implement the UI, or certify GA. Independent of designer and frontend writer. Read-only.

platform-accessibility-auditor.typicalTriggers: Independent accessibility certification of new/changed operational screens.
platform-accessibility-auditor.forbiddenOwnershipAssumptions: Does not implement the UI, does not own the design specification, and is independent of the designer and frontend writer.

platform-sensor-runtime-engineer.typicalTriggers: Sensor process, worker pools, leases, spool/uploader, Sensor health, 80% disk protection, or continue-to-collect during Core failover.
platform-sensor-runtime-engineer.forbiddenOwnershipAssumptions: Protocol/domain semantics (SNMP/ICMP/flow/syslog/gNMI/NETCONF/routing/discovery) belong to platform-network-engineer.; Device Pack schema/identification belongs to platform-device-pack-engineer.; Post-accept Kafka/ClickHouse streaming belongs to platform-telemetry-pipeline-engineer.; Does not choose unresolved two-Core fencing.

platform-infrastructure-cloud-engineer.typicalTriggers: Linux/Windows host monitoring, hypervisor/storage targets, Kubernetes/container targets, cloud-account monitoring, OpenTelemetry import boundaries, Redfish/BMC/OOB hardware, or customer PostgreSQL/MSSQL database targets.
platform-infrastructure-cloud-engineer.forbiddenOwnershipAssumptions: Platform Core/Sensor HA design remains exactly two Cores; this agent does not move Platform onto Kubernetes as its control plane.; Agent enrollment identity reconciliation belongs with identity/onboarding owners.; Network protocol collectors belong to platform-network-engineer.; Does not select unapproved cloud SDKs.

platform-telemetry-pipeline-engineer.typicalTriggers: After Sensor/Agent acceptance: canonical telemetry, Kafka consumers/producers, ClickHouse insert path, lag, poison, or produced→accepted→processed→inserted counters.
platform-telemetry-pipeline-engineer.forbiddenOwnershipAssumptions: Datastore engine/schema ownership remains with platform-database-reliability-engineer.; Sensor spool/uploader runtime belongs to platform-sensor-runtime-engineer.; API contract shape belongs to platform-api-platform-engineer.; Does not invent two-Core Kafka fencing.

platform-device-pack-engineer.typicalTriggers: Device Pack schema, vendor identification, metric/command mappings, pack versioning, certification, test-lab fixtures, or Redfish/BMC hardware pack collaboration.
platform-device-pack-engineer.forbiddenOwnershipAssumptions: SNMP/CLI/NETCONF/gNMI protocol engines belong to platform-network-engineer.; NCM privileged execution belongs to platform-ncm-remediation-engineer.; Does not add unapproved vendor SDKs.

platform-ncm-remediation-engineer.typicalTriggers: NCM jobs, config backup/diff/compliance, golden/drift, Change Plan binding, pre/post/rollback evidence, privileged CLI/NETCONF actions, auto-remediation proposals, or rollback.
platform-ncm-remediation-engineer.forbiddenOwnershipAssumptions: Protocol transport adapters belong to platform-network-engineer.; Device Pack command mapping schema belongs to platform-device-pack-engineer.; Cannot grant privilege via prompt content.

platform-integration-connector-engineer.typicalTriggers: New/changed outbound connectors, ITSM/notifications, change feeds, webhooks, carrier status, or connector certification.
platform-integration-connector-engineer.forbiddenOwnershipAssumptions: Notification Center recipient/RBAC policy belongs with identity/onboarding/notification owners.; Does not let vendor IDs override tenant/entity authority.; Does not invent SKUs or contractual SLOs.

platform-product-ui-designer.typicalTriggers: Material operational screen needs an implementation-ready specification after UX architecture and before React work.
platform-product-ui-designer.forbiddenOwnershipAssumptions: Does not own product requirements, React implementation, API contracts, authorization implementation, accessibility certification, final UI finish, or dependency/framework selection.
